notes.spec_basis: STU-RAS-151 'THE StudioAdjustment KIND ENUMERATION. The adjustment set is closed.' rows vibrance, colour_balance (nine values + preserve_luminosity), photo_filter (filter_colour, density, preserve_luminosity), black_and_white (six weights, tint_enabled, tint_hue, tint_saturation), channel_mixer ('stored as a weight list; the list length is channel-count-dependent'), selective_colour (nine ranges each a CMYK quadruple, method relative = 1 | absolute = 2), colour_lookup (lut artifact reference, lut_kind 3dlut | abstract | device_link, dither), gradient_map (gradient, reverse, dither), shadows_highlights ('the ten-field shape'), tone_compression (method, exposure, gamma, compression), match_colour, replace_colour (fuzziness 0..200); STU-RAS-152 canonical scales.
notes.readings_unverified_d5: Every second-set formula is a Studio reading (adjust_colour.rs cites each basis: GIMP colour-balance weights, W3C SetLum, Reinhard 2001/2002, the Adobe help relative/absolute example, the colour-range fuzziness falloff); Photoshop parity UNVERIFIED (D5). Merged-composite comparison against the psd-tools corpus files was not attempted (they carry default dialog values only).
notes.spec_gaps: STU-RAS-151 colour_lookup carries only an artifact reference: Folio adds an optional resolved cube by value (as STU-RAS-158 contours carry points); tone_compression method members are not enumerated by the spec (Folio uses the four HDR-toning methods); match_colour source selection is stored as resolved statistics. PSD export writes no adjustment blocks (the exporter keeps source bytes); grdm and clrL import stay unmapped.
notes.test_count: slice 1 = sub-slices 1a (4 tests), 1b (3), 1c (2); slice 2 = 2a (4), 2b (2); slice 3 (2); slice 4 (2); each within 5.
notes.spec_basis_knockout_placed: STU-RAS-041 'Studio MUST provide advanced/conditional blending on every layer as canonical StudioLayer fields: Blend-If ranges, knockout, ...'; STU-VEC-153 knockout four-member enumeration; STU-RAS-159 eight-value Blend-If (already implemented); STU-RAS-012 'The placed_asset layer MUST support both embedded mode ... and linked mode ... and MUST surface link health (up-to-date / modified / missing)'; STU-RAS-013 'Duplicating a placed_asset MUST create a shared-source instance (edits to the source propagate to all instances)'; STU-RAS-014 'non-destructive accumulated transforms'. Spec gaps: no knockout depth field (Folio knockout_depth added); placed_asset is a layer kind in the spec but Folio has none, so it is a raster-records sidecar on a raster layer (cached pixels as display truth, the interop-psd decision for smart objects); convert-to-layers, export-contents, package/collect, statistical stacks and link update-all are not implemented.

Placed assets: the transform is applied to the rendered source surface (STU-CMP-010 order); Photoshop's smart-object resampling is UNVERIFIED.
